usedFor: Zoho Zeptomail delivers your email, and Google Docs records suppressions through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a suppression entry (email or domain) is created or updated” in Zoho Zeptomail, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each blocked address or domain is written to a doc your team can check.

watchOut: This trigger is polling and also fires on updates, so one entry can be logged twice.
